title: Generate both transverse polarizations with a paid rational three-layer gate
statement: For nonparallel integer m,n,k=m+n with |k|^2!=1,choose coordinateunit r with d=(m cross n).r!=0 and delta=m cross n. Layer1 uses a=delta,b=(|n|^2m-(m.n)n)/|m cross n|^2: b.n=0,b.m=1,so the isolated interaction gives delta at k in both phases. Layer2 at t=k+r uses T(b)=d b+(b.k)delta for b in r-perp. T is injective onto(k-r)-perp,and projection to t-perp is invertible since t.(k-r)=|k|^2-1!=0. Two rational solves give the full t-perp. Layer3 applies the first construction to t and-r to obtain k cross r at k; it anddelta are independent because their r-components differ. Phase isolation and zero self-advection of each pure mode give both signs and local eta-sum d_j Q(xi_j),d_j>=0 rational. Canonical integer bases and fixed-size solves pay every nonzero integer denominator/minor,with polynomial local magnitudes and O(logN) bits. This is the known Nersesyan local span mechanism retained in a rational implementation,not a new physical-control rate or flattened quadratic formula.
